motion_history_image — VIDEOSTREAM motion op

• Datenarten: video → video

• Aufruf: import videostream; videostream.motion_history_image(video, tau: 'int' = 15, threshold: 'float' = 0.1) -> 'np.ndarray' (oder opsvideostream.get("motion_history_image"))

Verwendung

> Für diesen Operator gibt es noch keine Übersetzung. Es folgt der Originaltext unverändert.

Bobick–Davis Motion History Image per frame → `(T, H, W) in [0, 1] (video`).

Frame `t is the MHI of frames 0..t`: 1 where motion is happening,

decaying by `1/tau` per frame elsewhere. The last frame is the classic

single-image temporal template of the whole clip's motion.
